user_goal.text: Delete all Gmail drafts whose subject or body is empty.
user_goal.rationale: This is the official user instruction.

benchmark_success.rationale: Frozen TestTracker success requires every registered test to pass.

checked_by.text: The frozen AppWorld TestTracker evaluates four registered checks over the submitted task answer and start/end model state; success requires all four to pass.
checked_by.rationale: Only registered test contexts contribute passes or failures.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained submitted answer and official evaluator comparison result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered answer-comparison test passed?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end changed-model diff and official TestTracker result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evidence show that the changed model set is exactly gmail.Draft?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end Gmail draft diff and official TestTracker result
decisive_artifacts.question: Do the retained deleted draft IDs match the evaluator-selected empty-subject-or-body ID set, ignoring order?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end Gmail draft diff and official TestTracker result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evidence show that no Gmail draft was added or updated?

success_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert answers match.
success_if.rationale: The retained submitted answer and evaluator comparison result determine this check.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_002_edd36daec9c2] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert model changes match gmail.Draft.
success_if.rationale: The retained changed-model diff and TestTracker result determine this check.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_003_3f9dd20710d0] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: if public_data.operation is "and", assert private_data.empty_subject_and_body_draft_ids match the deleted draft IDs (ignore order). otherwise, assert private_data.empty_subject_or_body_draft_ids match the deleted draft IDs (ignore order).
success_if.rationale: The retained deleted draft IDs and evaluator result determine the operation-selected comparison.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_004_21ca688cf22c] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: obtain added, updated, deleted gmail.Draft records using models.changed_records, and assert 0 have been updated or added.
success_if.rationale: The retained Gmail draft diff and TestTracker result determine whether additions or updates occurred.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert answers match.
fail_if.rationale: An unsuccessful retained answer-comparison result is a registered failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_002_edd36daec9c2] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert model changes match gmail.Draft.
fail_if.rationale: Any retained changed-model set other than exactly gmail.Draft is a registered failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_003_3f9dd20710d0] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: if public_data.operation is "and", assert private_data.empty_subject_and_body_draft_ids match the deleted draft IDs (ignore order). otherwise, assert private_data.empty_subject_or_body_draft_ids match the deleted draft IDs (ignore order).
fail_if.rationale: A mismatch between retained deleted IDs and the operation-selected official ID set is a registered failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_004_21ca688cf22c] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: obtain added, updated, deleted gmail.Draft records using models.changed_records, and assert 0 have been updated or added.
fail_if.rationale: Any retained Gmail draft addition or update is a registered failure.

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.
